# SC-12: Check the invoices the day's orders produced

## Steps
1. Open the QuickBooks Online sandbox at the end of the day.
2. Check the day's invoices against the confirmed orders.

## Expected result
Every confirmed order has its invoice, and none was retyped (1 case).

## Data (by pointer only)
Source: the invoices in the sandbox after SC-06; records: the day's invoices; count: 1; fields: lines, quantities.
